text:
Alex Li: Heads up — multiple hosted API customers in us-west-2 reporting 504s and slow responses around 09:12 PDT. p95 spiked from 120ms -> 2.1s. Seeing high request queue depth on the gateway. :warning:
Priya Rao: I can see the same in Grafana. request_queue_depth jumped to ~140 on the ingress cluster, continuous-batcher backlog growing. Any recent deploys?
Samir Patel: No prod pushes in the last hour from runtime. Looks like an arrival-rate burst + some large context requests.
Marta Gomez: Support ticket #C-48213 opened by customer Foodly — they included traces showing timeouts at gateway. They also hit 502/504 intermittently.
Alex Li: Repro attempt: curl against hosted endpoint returned 504 with headers: `x-request-queue-depth: 137`, `x-rw-tail-latency-ms: 2050`.
Priya Rao: Logs from gateway:
```
2026-03-17T16:11:59Z ingress-gw-7f8d INFO enqueue_time_ms=4820 queue_depth=137 model_shard_wait_ms=1200
2026-03-17T16:12:03Z continuous-batcher WARN backlog=62 pending_batches=8 kvcache_load_ms=300
```
Samir Patel: Looks like continuous batcher isn't draining — backlog of ~60. Could be head-of-line blocking from a few very long requests. Suggest temporarily lowering batching window and increasing max concurrent dequeues.
Kai (opsbot): @oncall paging incident workspace created: https://in/incident/INC-2026-0317-9.
Marta Gomez: Quick mitigations proposed: 1) enable adaptive-shed to reject very large seq_len requests, 2) fallback routing to smaller model variant, 3) reduce batching window from 30ms -> 10ms. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Priya Rao: Agree. Also enable early-reject threshold at queue_depth 100 to protect tail latency.
Alex Li: I'll apply a conservative early-reject rule and drop the batching window. Samir, can you prepare a canary fallback route to the 8B quantized variant?
Samir Patel: On it. I have a route ready, will flip traffic for a single tenant to validate.
Marta Gomez: Noting customer comms: sent initial ack and ETA 30m.
Support-Bot: Customer ticket C-48213 updated: "Investigating gateway queue saturation; mitigation in progress."
Priya Rao: After lowering window and enabling early-reject, queue_depth fell to ~40 within 3m; continuous-batcher backlog dropped to ~6. p95 improved to ~250ms.
Alex Li: Flipped canary routing for Foodly to 8B variant — no more 504s for them.
Samir Patel: Adding postmortem checklist items: - add alert for sustained backlog > 40 for 5m, - tuning doc for batching window by workload, - test long-seq failure modes in staging.
Marta Gomez: Please capture repro steps in incident doc and attach the small log snippets. Also check billing correlation (no credits broken).
Alex Li: Repro steps I used:
1. Fire 200 concurrent requests with mixed sequence lengths (10% long seq ~8k tokens).
2. Observe gateway queue depth and continuous-batcher backlog.
3. Validate that early-reject at 100 prevents p95 > 1s.

Commands I ran:
```
siege -c200 -t30S --content-type 'application/json' 'https://api.hosted.rw/v1/generate'
kubectl logs -n ingress deploy/ingress-gw-7f8d --since=5m | grep backlog
```
Samir Patel: Will follow up with PR to make early-reject threshold configurable per-tenant and add a fallback policy template.
Priya Rao: Marking incident as mitigated for now; monitoring for recurrence. :white_check_mark:
Alex Li: Closing loop — escalate to RCA if we see >1 recurrence in 72h.
Kai (opsbot): Incident INC-2026-0317-9 status -> mitigated.
